sloka: ततो वालिनम् उद्यम्य सुग्रीवः शिबिकाम् तदा ।आरोपयत विक्रोशन् अंगदेन सह एव तु ॥४-२५-२८॥
transliteration: tato vālinam udyamya sugrīvaḥ śibikām tadā ।āropayata vikrośan aṁgadena saha eva tu ॥4-25-28॥

translations.english: Vali's deadbody was placed on the palanquin, decorated with many ornaments, garlands and clothes
